name: Termômetro do Mercado Solar – Análise Histórica

parameters.query: SELECT message_id, sender_name, group_name, group_jid, message_timestamp, message_type, ddd, content_text FROM public.messages WHERE message_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND content_text IS NOT NULL AND content_text <> '' ORDER BY message_timestamp ASC LIMIT 2000
